projects.name: Animelink
projects.description: Daily Connections-style puzzle game for anime fans. 3x3 grid, group 9 items into 3 hidden categories. Daily puzzles, archive, stats, streaks, hints. Shares MongoDB with Animedle.
projects.challenge: Anime fans had no daily NYT-Connections-style puzzle: group 9 items into 3 hidden categories, one fresh puzzle each day.
projects.impact: A daily Connections clone in production (animelink.lat) with a 3x3 grid, a 2/3 proximity hint, one hint per round, 4 dragon-ball lives, anime and character modes, an archive to replay any day, stats and streaks. Full MERN monorepo (React 18 + Vite 5, Express + MongoDB), i18n ES/EN/PT, deployed on Vercel + Render, sharing the database with Animedle.

projects.name: Animedle
projects.description: Wordle-style anime guessing game with multiple modes. Progressive hints, daily challenge, statistics, streaks. Full-stack with shared MongoDB collections (anime/character data).
projects.challenge: Anime fans had no daily guessing game that covered both series and characters, with progressive hints.
projects.impact: A daily guessing platform in production (animedle.lat) with 6 modes: Classic (anime and character, color-proximity table), Emoji (4 revealable emojis), Opening (audio clips), Pixel (progressively de-pixelated image), Silhouette, and VS multiplayer in real time (rooms). MERN stack, ES/EN/PT, sakura-petal Easter egg, in-app updates panel, sharing DB with AnimeLink.

projects.name: Deb8
projects.description: Web platform for formal, respectful debate. Text and voice debates between 2-4 people, with moderation, sanctions and personal statistics.
projects.challenge: Online arguments become chaotic and aggressive, so a formal debating space was needed.
projects.impact: A web app for text and voice debates between 2-4 people, with moderation, unanimous expulsion voting, sanctions and personal stats (proyecto integrador 2025).

projects.name: Paintball
projects.description: Online reservation system for paintball fields with real-time scheduling, duplicate booking prevention, payment integration, and admin panel.
projects.challenge: A real paintball field (running since 2010) booked its 3 courts by phone, causing double bookings and chaos on weekends.
projects.impact: A reservation platform with user accounts, per-court scheduling (date/time), pricing by capacity, and online payment — used in place of manual phone booking.

projects.name: MAYCO
projects.description: Logistics management system for shipping company: driver management, delivery tracking, returns, dispatch workflows. Custom PHP + MySQL with vanilla JS frontend.
projects.challenge: A shipping company managed drivers, deliveries and returns on paper, with no central system.
projects.impact: A full CRUD logistics app: driver registry (id, DNI, age, salary), delivery dispatch, shipment tracking and returns, with role-based PHP pages.

projects.name: MyFit
projects.description: Gym equipment management system with real-time availability tracking and an intuitive interface to simplify the administration of bars and accessories.
projects.challenge: Tracking gym equipment inventory (bars, kits) and materials was error-prone with spreadsheets.
projects.impact: An inventory app to build equipment kits, track stock and material inputs, and manage manufacturing of new gear.

projects.name: First Chatbot
projects.description: Conversational AI chatbot built with Streamlit and LangChain. Document QA, conversation memory, deployable to Streamlit Cloud.
projects.challenge: Making AI document Q&A accessible without a heavy setup.
projects.impact: A Streamlit + LangChain chatbot for document QA with conversation memory, deployable to Streamlit Cloud.

projects.name: EthereumCodes
projects.description: Smart contracts practice repo: voting systems (IVotingSystem, VotingSystem), ERC20 tokens, NFTs and access-control patterns. Certified 50-hour professional practicum by ETH KIPU and CABA Technical Schools.
projects.challenge: Learning Solidity by building real, reusable contract patterns.
projects.impact: Voting systems, ERC20 tokens and NFTs with access control, certified by a 50-hour ETH KIPU practicum.

projects.name: JBrain
projects.description: Educational quiz game with teacher and student roles, customizable features, user accounts, and persistent results stored in a database.
projects.challenge: Teachers needed a fun quiz tool with roles for students and teachers.
projects.impact: An educational quiz game with customizable features, user accounts and persistent results in a MySQL database.
